title: PDF Approval-Run Runbook
head: cad1447

phases.name: PREREQUISITE_CHECK
phases.description: Verify environment, token, and local packages before any remote operations
commands: # Verify GH_TOKEN is set and has repo scope
phases.validation_gate: ALL commands succeed. GH_TOKEN has repo scope. 6 local package directories present. Tests pass.

phases.name: CLOSE_EXISTING_PRS
commands: gh pr close $pr --repo aspose-pdf-net/Aspose.PDF.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples --comment 'Closing: will recreate with conflict-free branch against current main'
phases.validation_gate: All 6 PRs show state=CLOSED. Verify: gh pr list --state closed --repo aspose-pdf-net/Aspose.PDF.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples --json number,state

phases.name: RECREATE_PRS
phases.description: Create 6 new PRs from local packages via pipeline publish-pr command
phases.validation_gate: 6 new PRs created. Each PR must show mergeable=MERGEABLE. Run: gh pr list --repo aspose-pdf-net/Aspose.PDF.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples --json number,title,mergeable
phases.rollback: Close any failing new PRs: gh pr close <N> --repo aspose-pdf-net/Aspose.PDF.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples. Local packages are preserved. Re-run failed publish-pr command.
phases.capture_output: Record new PR numbers for Phase 4

phases.name: VERIFY_CONFLICT_FREE
phases.description: Verify all new PRs are conflict-free before merging
commands: # List all open PRs and check mergeable status
# Each PR should show mergeable: MERGEABLE
phases.validation_gate: ALL 6 new PRs show mergeable=MERGEABLE. If any show CONFLICTING, do NOT proceed to Phase 5.
phases.rollback: If any PR is CONFLICTING: close it, investigate the conflict source, and recreate from Phase 3 for that specific package only.

phases.name: MERGE_PRS
commands: # Merge each PR (replace <N> with actual PR numbers from Phase 3)
phases.validation_gate: All 6 PRs show state=MERGED. Verify: gh pr list --state merged --repo aspose-pdf-net/Aspose.PDF.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples --json number,state
phases.rollback: If merge fails mid-sequence: remaining unmerged PRs stay open and conflict-free. Resume from the failed PR. Already-merged PRs cannot be unmerged — open a revert PR if needed.

phases.name: POST_MERGE_VALIDATION
phases.description: Verify target repo state after all merges
commands: # Verify example count in target repo
phases.validation_gate: 19 PDF examples in target repo. Conservation equation passes. All tests pass.
phases.rollback: If conservation fails: investigate which examples are missing. The pipeline tracks contracts — check pipeline/contracts/pdf/ for expected list.

estimated_new_pr_numbers: Will be assigned by GitHub during Phase 3
sprint46_caveat_resolved: CAVEAT-04: Runbook now has phased execution, validation gates, and rollback for each phase
